meta.name: secrets-manager
meta.description: AWS Secrets Manager for secure secret storage and rotation. Use when storing credentials, configuring automatic rotation, managing secret versions, retrieving secrets in applications, or integrating with RDS.

copy.tagline: 安全存储和轮换密钥，集成到应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在AWS上管理数据库密码或API密钥
copy.tagline_en: Securely store and rotate secrets, integrate into apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage database passwords or API keys on AWS

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你安全地存储、检索和自动轮换数据库密码、API 密钥等敏感信息，并管理多个版本。
howto.when: 当你需要存储或获取凭证、配置自动轮换、管理密钥版本，或与 RDS 等 AWS 服务集成时触发。

say.text: 从 prod/myapp/database 密钥中获取当前密码。
say.note: Claude 会检索密钥的当前版本并返回密码。

say.text: 为 prod/myapp/database 密钥启用每30天自动轮换。
say.note: Claude 会配置 Lambda 函数进行自动轮换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you securely store, retrieve, and automatically rotate sensitive information like database passwords and API keys, and manage multiple versions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to store or retrieve credentials, configure automatic rotation, manage secret versions, or integrate with AWS services like RDS.

say_en.text: Create a secret named prod/myapp/database with database username and password.
say_en.note: Claude will call AWS CLI or boto3 to create the secret.

say_en.text: Retrieve the current password from the prod/myapp/database secret.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the current version of the secret and return the password.

say_en.text: Enable automatic rotation every 30 days for the prod/myapp/database secret.
say_en.note: Claude will configure a Lambda function for automatic rotation.
